pairs.subject: lazy-section-addressability
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout/ModuleRenderer/index.tsx:265 Searches found no data-anchor or anchorId declarations; this shell selects mutually exclusive module panes through navigation state rather than resolving named positions on a lazily assembled long page.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout/ModuleRenderer/index.tsx:291 Modules occupy the selected workspace pane, rather than separate addressable positions requiring reserved scroll geometry.
src/stores/navigationStore.ts:57 Shell navigation selects category state; it does not declare an in-page vocabulary whose entries must match DOM anchor hosts.
src/lib/shell/shellRoute.ts:70 Published module addresses select a workspace through query parameters; they do not resolve a section position or an internal scroll-tracking element.
src/hooks/useShellRouteSync.ts:38 Arrival activates the addressed module through state; scrolling toward an unmounted section is not the mounting trigger.
